role: Three-layer knowledge graph reset operations (hard, experience, skill-specific) with atomic Neo4j transactions.
detail: Module provides ResetResult dataclass and three async reset functions: reset_hard() removes skill and bootstrap layers while preserving anchor layer (SkillRegistry, core EvolutionRules, CoBeing self-node) and experience data; reset_experience() removes all sensor/guardian/inference provenance nodes while keeping anchor and skill layers; reset_skill(package_id) removes nodes for a specific skill package by installed_by_skill property. All operations use Neo4j DETACH DELETE for atomic removal of nodes and incident edges, wrapped in transactions with KnowledgeGraphError handling. Anchor nodes protected: 'registry:skills', 'evolution-rule-type-creation-threshold', 'evolution-rule-guardian-name-triggers-type', 'evolution-rule-prediction-error-demotion', 'rule:retrieval_threshold', 'cobeing-self'. Edge counting via Cypher MATCH before deletion to account for auto-deleted edges.
gotchas: Duplicate anchor_node_ids definition in reset_hard (lines 112-119 and 130-137); reset_experience uses same anchor list but filters by provenance_source IN ['sensor','guardian','inference']; reset_skill requires non-empty package_id validation; direct access to private _driver attribute from Neo4jGraphPersistence backend; edge counting via Cypher MATCH before deletion pattern used consistently across all three functions
